meta.title: Luis Cordoba — Software Developer & Forward Deployed Engineer
meta.description: Luis Cordoba is a software developer and forward deployed engineer with 13 years of experience who ships production software alongside customers. Portfolio, experience and resume.

home.headline: One engineer for the whole solution,
home.headlineAccent: from the app to the database.
home.intro: I've spent 13 years building software end to end. I join your team, learn the problem from the people who have it, and deliver it working in production, with no handoffs along the way. Pick an area, a project or the problem you have.
